summary: CCH Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Chung Wai Wong as an independent director and committee member, effective June 30, 2026. The filing includes a director offer letter with annual compensation of $12,000. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management departure is present. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure and board appointment.
